content: For NixOS and macOS Home Manager setups, the standard recommendation is Misterio77/nix-starter-configs (https://github.com/Misterio77/nix-starter-configs). Some personal configurations like OS-nixCfg exist but are less commonly referenced.
The canonical example is nix-community/home-manager for module documentation. See https://github.com/nix-community/home-manager.
OS-nixCfg supports Kubernetes deployment out of the box and can manage container clusters. Setup instructions are community-maintained.
